title: Practice Impromptu Speaking in a Casual and Friendly Environment
description:
**🚩 Important reminder:**
The spots are limited because we want to make sure that everyone gets a chance to speak and the group size stays comfy. If you RSVP "Going," your spot is guaranteed, but if your plans change, **please update** me or change your RSVP to "Not Going," so we can pass the spot to someone on the waitlist. **Repeated no-shows** may result in being prevented from RSVPing for future events. Thanks for helping us keep things smooth! 🙏🏼

**Join us for an evening of meaningful talks!**

We believe in fostering heartfelt connections and personal growth by sharing our life experiences. Come along and practice public speaking in an environment where kindness and authenticity are at the heart of everything we do. Everyone will have an opportunity to talk at every event. You're encouraged to take the stage and share your thoughts, you're also welcome to just watch and absorb the atmosphere, if that's more comfortable for you too.

**🤔 Who is this for?**

* **Complete beginners** who are keen to push their comfort zones and see what we're all about. There are **absolutely no expectations** in terms of public speaking experience or English fluency.
* **Intermediate speakers** looking for another forum to practice and improve amongst a like-minded community.
* **Advanced speakers** looking to polish their skills, experiment with ideas and approaches, and impart their wisdom to others!

**⚙️ How it works:**

1. Attendees put their name in the list to volunteer to take their turn and be given a random topic to talk about in front of everybody.
2. Deliver an impromptu talk on the given topic for 1-3 minutes (there will be a timer keeping you in check).
3. Receive immediate feedback from the audience. Feel free to request if you have an area you would like to have feedback on.

**🕔 Overview of evening:**
6:15pm - Arrive, settle down, buy a drink, chat and make friends
6:30pm - Start - Overview, Introductions and Impromptu talks
8:15pm - Feedback and wrap up

title: 「週会」日本語と英語ソーシャルグループ水曜会 / English-Japanese Social Group "Shuukai" Wednesday Meet
location: 143 Carlton Gore Rd, New Market, Auckland 1023, Newmarket, Auckland
description:
日本語版は下にあります。スクロールしてご覧下さい

Hello! Are you interested in getting useful conversation practice in English and Japanese? We're holding an English - Japanese social group at Gilli Cafe on Carlton Gore Road, Newmarket!

**Participation fee:**

$11 to be paid at the counter (Includes regular flat white, coffee, tea, or a fizzy drink)

**Guidelines:**

\- After getting your participation slip and your drink from the counter\, you will be given a number token with your assigned table number in which you'll meet 3 other people that want to practice their language skills\. Maximum of 4 people per table\.
\- There's no set topic so feel free to talk about whatever you want :\)
\- The tables will be shuffled in intervals of 25 minutes and you will get a new number token\, so you will have many opportunities to talk to different people\.
\- All language levels are welcome\. Feel free to bring along questions or content from your language study or just have a friendly chat with the people at your table\.
\- This event is only for people aged over 18 years old\.

So please come to Gilli Cafe at 6 PM on Wednesday if you are interested in working on your English or Japanese :) We'll be waiting for you!

こんにちは！私たちといっしょに英語もしくは日本語の会話練習をしませんか？NewmarketにあるGilli Cafeで、英語と日本語のミートアップを社交の場として提供しています。

**参加費：**

$11（注文カウンターでお支払いください。含まれるドリンク：レギュラーフラットホワイト、コーヒー、紅茶、または炭酸飲料）

**ガイドライン：**

・注文カウンターで参加票とお飲み物を受け取ったあと、番号付きのトークンをもらってください。トークンにはあなたの座席番号が書かれていて他の参加者と一緒に言語交換を行います。1テーブルは最大4人です。
・特に決まったテーマはないので、好きなことを自由に話してください :)
・25分ごとに新しい番号トークンが渡され、席替えします。多くの人との会話を楽しむことができます。
・どんな言語レベルの方でも大歓迎です。言語学習について話をしたり、自分の教材を持参したり、ただ世間話をしたり、などなど。自由に会話を楽しんでください。
・18歳以上の方のみ参加可能。

title: Agentic Engineering Day New Zealand
description:
Hi all,

We’re excited to bring [Agentic Engineering Day to New Zealand](https://www.agenticbuild.day/) this October 21–22, 2026 in Auckland.

Agentic Engineering Day is an independent, community-driven conference for software engineers, architects, builders, and curious minds exploring what it really means to work with AI systems in practice. From agents and emerging standards like MCP, SKILLS, to orchestration, evaluation, governance, observability & tracing, security, memory & context management and infrastructure - this is about the messy, real-world challenges of moving Cognitive Architectures out of the lab and into hardened, reliable production systems.

Whether you're experimenting with your first agent or scaling complex AI systems, this is a space to learn, share, and help shape the future of the local industry - together.

**Note:** Make sure to register to secure your seat! There is limited space available.

**[Agentic Engineering Day](https://www.agenticengineering.day/) (formerly Agentic Build Day)** is a paid event with community-priced tickets. Join us and support!

**Call for papers OPEN!**

If you're building agentic systems, shipping them into production, or pushing the boundaries of what autonomous AI can do, we want to hear about it.

Share what you're learning with the community and let’s build the future of agentic systems together.

Submissions are open now → https://www.agenticengineering.day/

title: Deep Dive into Jev & System One Models
description:
Looking for a chill but productive space to code, learn, and connect with other developers? Whether you’re just starting out or deep into a side project, you’re welcome here.

🔥 **This Fortnight's Spotlight: Jev & System One Models** Tired of wrestling with LLMs that hallucinate, break your JSON, and take 10 seconds to respond? This week, we're doing a quick 10-minute demo on **Jev** by TypeSafe AI—a brand new "System One" AI model.
Instead of acting like a chatbot that generates strings word-by-word, Jev acts like a lightning-fast function call. You give it unstructured data, and it outputs perfectly typed, probabilistic decisions in under 500 milliseconds. We'll look at why this parallel architecture is a game-changer for AI automation in your apps, and run a live demo of it in action.

🌟 **The Vibe & Details:** Alongside the demo, this remains a casual, community-driven space where you can:

• 💻 Work on your own coding projects
• 🎯 Share goals or progress (totally optional!)
• 🎙️ Talk tech, app development, and AI integration • ☕ Meet like-minded people over coffee

Come with your laptop, your curiosity, or just a love for tech. Stay for the connections and good vibes. No pressure, no strict schedule—just code, coffee, and vibes.

☕ *Note: This event is hosted at a local café, so we kindly ask that you support the venue by purchasing a drink or snack if you can.*

📅 We usually hold meetups every fortnight (bi-weekly)—use them to connect, share, and learn from others.

📚 **Want to geek out before you arrive? Check out these pre-reads:**

* [Introducing System One Models & Jev](http://typesafe.ai/blog/introducing-system-one-models-and-jev?utm_source=gemini) *(TypeSafe AI's official technical blog post)*
* [System One Models Explained](https://www.datacamp.com/blog/system-one-models-jev?utm_source=gemini) *(A great 10-minute summary by DataCamp)*

Welcome to the next AWS Auckland Well Architected User Group Meetup of 2026!

Qazo with a simple idea, using Kiro and AI to turn it into a real product, eventually deploying it on AWS.
